name: Diego Hernandez
bio:
Diego's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Guadalajara, where he spent countless hours watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This early exposure fueled his desire to work within the industry, leading him to pursue a degree in marketing with a focus on digital media. He joined Porsche Penske Motorsport eager to apply his skills and learn from the best. 

As a marketing coordinator, Diego is responsible for crafting engaging content, managing social media channels, and developing innovative campaigns to enhance the team's brand presence. He believes in data-driven strategies and is always seeking new ways to connect with fans and sponsors. His ambition is to become a marketing director and lead successful teams.

Diego is a driven individual who thrives in fast-paced environments. His creativity, technical understanding, and enthusiasm make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Diego is of average height with a lean build and a confident demeanor.

quirks: Always has a pack of spicy tamarind candy on his desk.
Meticulously organizes his digital files using a complex color-coding system.
Prefers to work with noise-canceling headphones, even in quiet environments.
